title: Backoffice frontend test command has no executable tests
environment: Node 24.11.0; repository lockfile npm ci; Vitest 4.1.10; 750 MiB Node old-space ceiling
actualResult: TypeScript and generated 96-operation client PASS; npm test fails because Vitest finds zero test files; production build is not reached.
rootCause: The package advertises a complete test stage and includes Vitest plus Vue Test Utils, but the maintained Backoffice frontend contains no test/spec file. The newly completed employee contact behavior therefore has no executable regression owner.
repairPolicy: Add real model and Vue component behavior tests for required validation, trimming, contact entry, explicit clear controls and loading behavior; retain the normal failing zero-test default.
sourceFix: Added model validation tests plus a mounted jsdom Vue component suite covering the complete contact payload, explicit clear semantics, input disabling and loading-state submit protection.
verification: Vitest executes 2 files and 6 tests with zero failures; complete npm verify reaches and passes production build. Generated dependencies and dist are deleted afterward.
passCriteria: Employee contact and clear payload behavior covered
